subject: GreenBay Health: request for DR/BCP evidence and RTO/RPO
messages:
From: Lydia Morales <lmorales@greenbayhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: BCP/DR RTO & RPO details for SOC2 audit

Hi Nikhil,

We are preparing for GreenBay Health's SOC 2 Type II assessment next month and our audit team has asked for detailed BCP/DR evidence for vendors that process PHI. Specifically, can you provide the following for Redwood's hosted inference service that GreenBay uses (prod region us-west-2):

- RTO and RPO targets (and observed averages) for critical components (API gateway, model serving, KV cache, metadata DB)
- A copy of the Disaster Recovery runbook (redacted as needed)
- Date and brief outcome of the last full DR exercise / tabletop (and any post-mortem)
- Backup retention policy and last backup manifest export
- Contact for on-call DR escalation during the audit window

If possible, we need these artifacts by EOD Friday (2026-04-09) so our auditor can include them in the evidence packet. Please let me know if you need an NDA or redaction guidance.

Thanks,
Lydia Morales
Director, Security Assurance
GreenBay Health
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Morales <lmorales@greenbayhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: BCP/DR RTO & RPO details for SOC2 audit

Hi Lydia — thanks for the heads up and the due date. We're committed to supporting your auditor.

Plan:
- I'll coordinate artifacts and send a redacted runbook + RTO/RPO table by end of day tomorrow (2026-04-09).
- Monica (ops) will pull the DR exercise summary and backup manifest; Karthik is copied in case procurement needs to surface any paperwork.
- We'll provide a single zipped evidence bundle and a short cover note describing what we've redacted and why.

Two quick Qs:
1) Do you need itemized S3 keys for backups, or is a manifest summary sufficient?
2) If an NDA is required for unredacted runbook content, please confirm and we can route a narrow NDA.

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Internal: Draft runbook and RTO/RPO table (for redaction)

Nikhil / Karthik,

I've pulled the DR runbook and a draft RTO/RPO CSV. Key items included:
- runbook_v2.pdf (full ops playbook) — contains internal hostnames and run IDs that must be redacted before external sharing
- rto_rpo_table_2026Q1.csv — per-service targets and measured medians for Q1 2026
- dr_exercise_summary_202601.pdf — tabletop summary from Jan 2026, includes timeline and gaps found
- backup_manifest_202603.csv — nightly backup manifest export (objs listed); includes S3 paths

Suggested redaction policy:
- Replace internal hostnames, cluster IDs, and REST endpoint IPs with placeholders (e.g. <redacted-host>)
- Keep RTO/RPO numeric values intact; those are required by auditors
- Omit direct links to on-call runbooks for third-party vendor ops (we can provide contact instead)

If we need to share unredacted runbook excerpts, we should request a narrow NDA or request an auditor visit under supervision. Happy to process redactions and produce a cover letter.

Monica
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: runbook_v2.pdf (internal), rto_rpo_table_2026Q1.csv (internal)
From: Lydia Morales <lmorales@greenbayhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-09T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: BCP/DR RTO & RPO details for SOC2 audit

Nikhil — thanks, that timeline works. Quick clarifications from our auditor:

- The auditor would like the RTO/RPO numeric targets and the observed medians for the past 12 months. If you can include a short note on how medians were computed (eg metric name and query), that helps.
- For the DR exercise, a one-page summary and the date is sufficient; if there's a formal post-mortem, a redacted version is useful.
- Backup manifest: a summary with counts, total size, and retention windows is OK — we don't need the full key list.
- Certificate snapshots and snapshot timestamps (for services) are requested if available.

Also attaching a short snippet of our SIG questionnaire where the auditor flagged follow-up items — can you confirm which of those we should expect in the package?

Appreciate the quick turn.

Regards,
Lydia

---
Attachment stub: greenbay_SIG_followup_excerpt.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-04-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Redactions + delivery checklist

Team — quick checklist before we publish the bundle externally: 
1) Redact hostnames, internal run IDs, and AWS account numbers from the runbook_v2.pdf.
2) Produce rto_rpo_table_2026Q1.csv with columns: service, target_rto, target_rpo, observed_median_rto, observed_median_rpo, measurement_query.
3) Summarize DR exercise in a one-page PDF with date and remediation status; include link to post-mortem ticket (internal ref only).
4) Backup manifest: provide counts, total size, last successful backup timestamp, and retention policy statement.
5) Include certificate snapshot filenames and timestamps if available; if not, provide rotation policy.

If GreenBay needs unredacted internal artifacts, ask them to sign the narrow NDA (DocuSign link below) and we can share via secure drive. Otherwise we deliver the redacted bundle.

DocuSign (NDA narrow): https://docusign.com/abcdef-DR-NDA-2026
